skill.name: Commit/Evade
skill.strategic_description: Player commits to an evasive attack/movement, producing an air slash while clearing past orb/enemy hazards and transitioning into a beam/flame platform section.

preconditions: Player is positioned adjacent to an orb or enemy hazard requiring evasion.
Player has sufficient momentum or charge to initiate an air slash.
The subsequent terrain contains a beam or flame platform requiring precise transition.
steps: Execute a rapid forward dash while simultaneously activating the air slash attack to clear the immediate hazard.
Maintain forward momentum through the slash animation to bridge the gap to the beam/flame platform section.
Land precisely on the target platform section, ensuring the transition completes without collision with the cleared hazard.
success_criteria: The player successfully clears the orb/enemy hazard using the air slash.
The player transitions safely onto the beam or flame platform without taking damage.
The sequence results in a positive cumulative reward or score increase.
abort_criteria: The player takes damage (damage_taken=true) during the slash or transition.
The player fails to land on the target platform and falls into a hazard.
Abort if no progress after expected duration
